hero_slides.summary: I'm Shahal Ahammed K. I connect consumer research, data analytics and generative AI. I run UAE & KSA smartphone studies, then build the Python pipelines and live AI apps that scale them.
I built and shipped the "AI Studio" generative AI web apps for two smartphone launches at vivo Middle East, using Cloudflare Pages, the OpenAI Image API and Python mask pipelines.
I combine comment sentiment analysis, theme coding and statistical testing across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube to show which creators fit the UAE and KSA markets.
MSc Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence, A+ grade) from the University of Kerala, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, and the Rajya Puraskar state honour.

case_studies.title: AI Studio
case_studies.subtitle: Generative AI campaign experiences, shipped for two vivo smartphone launches
case_studies.challenge: Create personalised smartphone launch campaign imagery from a visitor's selfie, placing them inside the official key visual in the campaign outfit and holding the phone, while keeping the brand logo, product and headline lettering pixel-exact.
case_studies.approach: A custom Python masking pipeline that separates person, protected-logo, product and hand masks and rebuilds occluded campaign lettering, paired with gender-aware prompt engineering and a serverless Cloudflare Pages stream.

layers.name: Mask Pipeline
layers.detail: A Python script turns the designer's master key visual into person, protected-logo, product and hand masks, and reconstructs hidden parts of the campaign lettering so generated hair falls naturally in front of it.

layers.name: Gender Prompting
layers.detail: Prompts tuned against real generations for facial likeness, pose, scale, smile and studio lighting, with automatic gender detection so women are never rendered with the original male model's hand or build.

layers.name: Cloudflare Edge
layers.detail: Migrated from a Python/FastAPI server on Render to Cloudflare Pages by moving image compositing into the browser and streaming the OpenAI Image API response server-side.

layers.name: Frame Mode
layers.detail: A fast, no-AI “Profile with Frame” mode that creates a branded square profile picture with interactive drag-and-zoom positioning.

case_studies.title: Social Media Analytics
case_studies.subtitle: Every vivo launch campaign tracked in one place, with each creator's performance across TikTok, Instagram & YouTube
case_studies.challenge: vivo Middle East runs creator (KOL) campaigns for every smartphone launch across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Results sat on separate platforms, so there was no single view of how a campaign and each of its creators performed, or how one launch compared with the next.
case_studies.approach: A campaign analytics view for every launch: each creator's results side by side, audience reactions, and clear comparisons with earlier launches and competitors, so the team can see what worked and plan the next campaign.

layers.name: Campaign Overview
layers.detail: Every launch campaign gets its own overview: the phone, the market and the creators involved, tracked the same way each time.

layers.name: Creator Performance
layers.detail: Each creator's content is compared side by side across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, showing who delivered for the campaign.

layers.name: Audience Insights
layers.detail: Audience segments and engagement show which people each creator reached and how they responded to the campaign.

layers.name: Comparisons
layers.detail: Campaigns are compared across launches, such as V70 vs V60 vs V50, and against competitor benchmarks, guiding which creators to work with next.

case_studies.confidential_note: Real campaign reports are confidential. The samples here use fictional creators, numbers and comments, and leave out costs.

case_studies.title: Campaign Sentiment Analysis
case_studies.subtitle: A second web app that reads the comments on a campaign's creator posts and turns them into sentiment and themes
case_studies.challenge: Reach and engagement show how far a campaign travelled, not what audiences thought of the phone. The answers sit in the comments under each creator's post, far too many to read by hand for every launch.
case_studies.approach: A web app that classifies every comment as positive, neutral or negative, codes it into themes such as camera, design, battery and price, and compares those themes across platforms and markets with statistical testing.

layers.name: Comment Capture
layers.detail: Comments on each creator's campaign posts are brought together for the campaign, so every reaction is linked to its creator and platform.

layers.name: Sentiment
layers.detail: Every comment is classified as positive, neutral or negative, giving each creator and campaign a clear sentiment picture.

layers.name: Theme Coding
layers.detail: Comments are coded into themes such as camera, design, battery and price, showing what people love and where the campaign and price messaging can improve.

layers.name: Testing
layers.detail: Themes are compared across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, with statistical testing for UAE and KSA audiences.

case_studies.confidential_note: Real campaign reports are confidential. The samples here use fictional creators, numbers and comments, and leave out costs.
